title: Model Submarket Opportunity Portraits & Adoption Velocity Hypotheses
creator: Mariana Ortiz
description: Goal: Produce a set of 6-8 'submarket portraits' that capture distinct segments of the open and commercial model landscape (e.g., on-device chat models, embeddings-as-a-service, multimodal retrievers, low-latency instruction models). For each portrait we will: 1) define the buyer and technical profile, 2) estimate near-term adoption velocity (0-24 months) with rationale and leading indicators, 3) map typical procurement/partnering patterns and trigger events, 4) quantify likely deployment constraints (latency, TCO, regulatory), 5) recommend Redwood product hooks (routing, quantization presets, Dedicated requirements, Console metrics to surface). Deliverables: consolidated brief (one-pager per portrait), a prioritized list of 12 hypotheses about which submarkets are accelerating vs. stalling, and an evidence tracker that ties each hypothesis to primary signals (HF downloads, GitHub activity, cloud partner telemetry, RFP signals from sales, customer requests). Methodology: combine automated signal ingestion (public repo/activity, model card releases, HF download trends), qualitative field interviews with 8 customers/prospects, and a small pricing/latency sensitivity matrix for each portrait. Success criteria: brief approved by PM leadership, at least 4 hypotheses validated by outbound field checks, and 3 clear product experiments (e.g., routing policy tweak, new quant profile recommendation, console dashboard) proposed for Q4. This ticket coordinates research, data ingestion engineering, and GTM enablement artifacts.
